metrics.name: Rebounds
metrics.glossary: Total rebounds. Offensive/defensive split only from 1973-74.

metrics.name: Three Pointers Made
metrics.glossary: Three-point field goals made. The three-point line arrived in 1979-80.

metrics.name: Plus/Minus
metrics.glossary: Team point differential while the player is on the floor.

metrics.name: Effective FG %
metrics.glossary: (FGM + 0.5*3PM) / FGA. Adjusts field goal percentage for the extra value of a three.

metrics.name: True Shooting %
metrics.glossary: PTS / (2 * (FGA + 0.44*FTA)). Shooting efficiency including free throws.

metrics.name: Three Point Attempt Rate
metrics.glossary: 3PA / FGA. Share of field goal attempts taken from three.

metrics.name: Free Throw Rate
metrics.glossary: FTA / FGA. Free throws drawn per field goal attempt.

metrics.name: Usage %
metrics.glossary: Share of team possessions a player ends while on the floor.

metrics.name: Assist %
metrics.glossary: Share of teammate field goals a player assists while on the floor.

metrics.name: Offensive Rebound %
metrics.glossary: Share of available offensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.

metrics.name: Defensive Rebound %
metrics.glossary: Share of available defensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.

metrics.name: Rebound %
metrics.glossary: Share of available rebounds grabbed while on the floor.

metrics.name: Steal %
metrics.glossary: Share of opponent possessions ending in a steal by the player.

metrics.name: Block %
metrics.glossary: Share of opponent two-point attempts blocked by the player.

metrics.name: Player Impact Estimate
metrics.glossary: A player's share of the box-score events generated in the games they played (NBA.com).

metrics.name: Game Score
metrics.glossary: Hollinger's single-game rating: PTS + 0.4*FGM - 0.7*FGA - 0.4*(FTA-FTM) + 0.7*OREB + 0.3*DREB + STL + 0.7*AST + 0.7*BLK - 0.4*PF - TOV.

metrics.name: Player Efficiency Rating
metrics.glossary: Hollinger's per-minute rating, pace and league adjusted so that the league average is 15.00 every season.

metrics.name: Win Shares per 48
metrics.glossary: Win Shares per 48 minutes. League average is about 0.100.

metrics.name: Box Plus/Minus
metrics.glossary: Box-score estimate of points per 100 possessions above a league-average player. Needs steals, blocks and turnovers, so it starts in 1973-74.
